test_cases.name: D15 audit CRITICAL: heredoc PWEOF bug — device-breakpoint-test output literal '${WIDTH}'
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D15 CRITICAL: P-QD7-device-breakpoint-test.md (probe spec) co heredoc voi single-quoted delimiter '<< PWEOF'. Trong bash, single-quoted heredoc KHONG expand variables → ${WIDTH}, ${HEIGHT}, ${URL} la literal strings trong Playwright config → probe FUNDAMENTALLY BROKEN if executed as-spec'd. IMP-QD7-014 (P0): rewrite theo QD4 temp-file pattern.

input.scenario: Spawn wf-fix-compat voi profile=deep. P-QD7-device-breakpoint-test chay voi DEFAULT_BREAKPOINTS=[{width:375,height:812}] va BASE_URL='http://localhost:3000'. Do heredoc PWEOF, Playwright config nhan '${WIDTH}' literal thay vi 375.

expected.current_behavior: Playwright receives literal '${WIDTH}'/'${HEIGHT}'/'${URL}' → launch fails OR tests wrong viewport
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD7_014: Use temp file pattern (like QD4 CWV): write Playwright config to /tmp/playwright-compat-$$.js → run → cleanup

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD7-014: probe spec uses '<< PWEOF' (single-quoted) → bash variable expansion disabled → Playwright config broken. SAU IMP-QD7-014: phai dung temp file pattern hoac double-quoted heredoc << EOF. Root cause: bash $VAR vs JS template literal confusion in same file (AF-D1).
test_cases.audit_ref: 08-qd7-compat-audit.md Phase 2 D15 CRITICAL + Phase 3 SPEC_GAP D15 + IMP-QD7-014

test_cases.name: D10 audit: broken CDG bash — deprecated probe emit CDG-DEPS-DOWN nhung cdg=false
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D10: wf-fix-probe-static-deprecated.sh (bash) line 210 emit signal voi cdg_flags: ['CDG-DEPS-DOWN'] khi deprecated dependency resolution fails. Nhung dim.json co cdg=false → CDG handler khong dang ky → flag bi IGNORE. Same pattern nhu QD4-D4. IMP-QD7-007 (P1 MERGE QD4-D4): fix consistency: cdg=true in dim.json OR remove CDG emit from bash.

input.scenario: wf-fix-probe-static-deprecated.sh chay, npm registry unavailable cho package version check. Probe line 210 emit cdg_flags=['CDG-DEPS-DOWN']. dim.json co cdg=false.

expected.current_behavior: CDG-DEPS-DOWN emitted by bash but ignored (cdg=false) → orchestrator not aware of registry failure
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD7_007: EITHER dim.json cdg=true + handler registered, OR bash probe removes cdg_flags emit

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD7-007: CDG-DEPS-DOWN trong signal khong duoc xu ly → npm registry failure silently ignored. SAU IMP-QD7-007: consistent (cdg flag = dim.json cdg setting). Cross-dim: QD4 TC-audit-QD4-001 co same test. IMP-024 CDG Governance (5-dim) merge.
